description: Main source of drinking water in Kenya is a dataset listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange (HDX), an open data portal, published or maintained by Majidata (inactive). This dataset contains information on Dwelling occupants owning the dwelling they live in and are using piped water. The dataset was collected for the Maji-data project. Coverage: Kenya. The portal files it under the publisher Majidata (inactive). Its tags are governance and civil society, water sanitation and hygiene-wash. It offers 1 resource(s) in CSV. The portal shows 2023-09-27 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
